per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: sold by total disk (200 GB on mini); no single-file cap is published

egress.terms: 'Unlimited Bandwidth' and 'Unlimited Active Transfers', with an 8MB/s average upload speed on mini.

interface_detail: 'FTP/FTPS/FXP Access' and web-based file access on every account.
tooling: FTP or FTPS client, FXP between servers, and the web file manager; no API or CLI is documented
chaining: A USD 2 per week 200 GB box, useful for a short burst of retrieval; mini does not allow public trackers

limits.value: 8MB/s average upload on mini; 15MB/s on 100mbit, 30MB/s on 1gbit, 80MB/s on 1gbit-ssd

limits_note: Packages: mini 200 GB USD 6/month, 100mbit from 400 GB USD 10/month, 1gbit 1 TB USD 25/month, max 6 TB USD 50/month. Public trackers are not allowed on mini.

confidence_note: Packages, prices and protocols are on the vendor pages read on 2026-11-03. A measured rung needs a slot and a timed transfer.
